title: Witch Sound Backport
description: Incorporates the witch sounds from the combat update into older editions of Minecraft!
body:
This resource pack adds idle, hurt, and death sounds for the witch mob.

Unfortunately, only 1.7.x is supported due to it being the only version with sound hooks for the witch. If someone knows how to code (unlike me :p) i would love to make it into a proper mod.

Special thanks to [this](https://www.reddit.com/r/Minecraft/comments/28fute/adding_sounds_to_witches_17_json/) reddit post for helping me accomplish this.
